content.title: 65% Off All Muslims Day Yearly Plans for the Next 3 Days!
content.subtitle: May every day bring you closer to the remembrance of your Lord more peaceful.
content.body:
Muslims Day is built around one simple vision: that every morning of a Muslim begins with the remembrance of their Lord and that the entire day is filled with the tranquility of righteous deeds. Our goal is simple—to make your today a little better than yesterday.

From prayer alerts for every Salah, Sehri and Iftar timings, Quran recitation and Tafsir, morning and evening Dhikr, Durood and Istighfar reminders, to an Amal Tracker and digital Tasbeeh counter—we have carefully integrated almost every essential tool needed to support a person’s daily spiritual growth and track their progress in worship.

A Dedicated Team and a Huge Effort Behind the Scenes

To keep this continuous guide to daily worship available for millions of people around the world, a dedicated team of 15 to 20 people works tirelessly behind the scenes. Maintaining the app’s backend, researching and developing new features, content and digital marketing, user support, and significant monthly server costs all require substantial technical investment. Our primary goal is to bring the universal teachings of Islam to millions of people and help them organize their worship. To sustain this large-scale da’wah mission, we have brought some features under the premium plan—allowing our users to become part of this mission as well.

A Special 3-Day Gift: 65% Mega Discount on All Yearly Plans

For those who have been thinking about becoming a long-term premium member of Muslims Day but have been hesitant or kept postponing for various reasons, this special offer is for you. For the next 3 days, all our yearly plans are available with a 65% mega discount—so you can make your journey of worship easier with a very small contribution and join our long-term journey in supporting this noble mission of Islam.

footer_button.hint: Be a part of this da’wah mission that makes the daily worship journey of millions of believers easier.
